mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sort_order, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COUNT(v.id) AS variable_count FROM telemetry_longterm_partition p LEFT JOIN telemetry_longterm_variable v ON v.partition_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sort_order, p.created_at, p.updated_at ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT id, name, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM telemetry_longterm_partition WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_longterm_partition SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE telemetry_longterm_variable SET partition_id = NULL WHERE partition_id = #{id}
